choices.statement: Problem, AttemptExp, Criticism, and Standard are overlapping Content subtypes.
Event is a distinct opaque carrier.
An interval use that needs an endpoint carries an explicit endpoint witness.
alpha inhabits an opaque Response carrier.
Collection, domain, class, metric, encoding, and horizon objects receive distinct opaque carriers.
Formula and physical or modal carriers are reified only inside a named physical module.
Provenance and counterfactual objects receive explicit graph and intervention structures.
The CCPResult endpoint is Content, with separate problem-situation evidence.
Point satisfaction, interval satisfaction, and event occurrence are separate forms.
A physical region reaches an abstract predicate only through an explicit abstractImage term.
Rep has a Token-or-State ground witness; Represents existentially hides that witness.
Retained has explicit system, content, history, and time arguments.
Authors receives an explicit episode, boundary, and provenance context.
Each contrast predicate receives the entity being classified.
OCA receives explicit history, interval, time, equivalence level, and boundary baselines.
Possible receives theory, tolerance, and resource baselines.
UED receives a physical-admissibility profile through its enabling envelope.
